core.title: 3-5/8 Inch Smooth Iron Cup Pull, Acorn APVBP

text.description_html:
Acorn APVBP, 3-5/8 Inch Smooth Black Iron Cup Pull

The finish of the Smooth Iron Cup Pull is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it was originally forged. Made of iron, it has a lifetime no rust warranty. This oval shaped cup pull cabinet handle is great for drawers, furniture or cabinet doors. It is surface mounted to the door's face in the classic early american style.

Specifications of the Smooth Iron Cup Pull:

  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!
  • Length: 3-5/8"
  • Width: 2"
  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron

Sold individually. Package includes 1 cup pull and hardware for a surface mounted application.



** This item is being discontinued by Acorn. Very limited quantities available.
